alt: 幾名居民合力操作抽水器、整理引水溝，把儲水槽的水引進乾裂田地，讓幼苗得到灌溉。
scene_prompt: A rural community works together to transform a dry field during a drought. Three adult neighbors finish a modest irrigation channel from a rainwater storage tank and small hand-operated pump; water now reaches neat green seedlings amid previously cracked brown earth. One adult checks the channel slope, another works the pump, another directs water. Clear physical connection from stored water to green field; practical human cooperation overcomes drought, without harming nature or depicting gods.
